test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The height and radius of a cone-shaped storage tank are 9 ft. and 7 ft., respectively. Find the volume of water the tank can hold? (Use \pi=(22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Height (h) = 9 ft.

Radius (r) = 7 ft.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cone (V) = (1/3) × π × r² × h

**Calculation:**

V = (1/3) × (22/7) × 7² × 9

⇒ V = (1/3) × (22/7) × 49 × 9

⇒ V = (1/3) × 22 × 7 × 9

⇒ V = (1/3) × 1386

⇒ V = 462 cubic ft.

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
